Hi Alex —

Following up with the SOC 2 package we discussed. Attached is our Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_Q2_2026.pdf which includes the Type II report, control matrix, and a short executive summary. I also uploaded the packet to a shared Drive link for easier distribution: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_Q2_2026

Highlights the security controls most relevant to FintechCo:
- Encryption at rest and in transit (KMS integrations)
- Access controls and role-based permissions
- Audit logs and retention policies (configurable per deployment)
- Dedicated options for private deployments (VPC/on-prem)

If it helps, Nikhil can run through the control mapping with your security reviewer — happy to schedule 15 minutes. Anything else you'd like included (e.g., additional evidence, architecture diagrams)?

Best,
